text: {"version":1,"kind":"analytics","reading":"Keep the top ten players by points per game in calendar 2017 (at least 20 games played) and add rebounds per game and assists per game for them.","measures":[{"derived":{"kind":"ratio","numerator":"column:dev.player_game_stats.pts","denominator":"column:dev.player_game_stats.played","numeratorAggregation":"sum","denominatorAggregation":"sum"},"alias":"points_per_game"},{"ref":"column:dev.player_game_stats.played","aggregation":"sum","alias":"games_played"},{"derived":{"kind":"ratio","numerator":"column:dev.player_game_stats.reb","denominator":"column:dev.player_game_stats.played","numeratorAggregation":"sum","denominatorAggregation":"sum"},"alias":"rebounds_per_game"},{"derived":{"kind":"ratio","numerator":"column:dev.player_game_stats.ast","denominator":"column:dev.player_game_stats.played","numeratorAggregation":"sum","denominatorAggregation":"sum"},"alias":"assists_per_game"}],"groupBy":[{"ref":"dimension:player_game_stats.player_id","role":"key"}],"display":["dimension:player_game_stats.player_name"],"filters":[{"ref":"measure:1","op":"gte","values":[20],"source":"inherited"}],"ordering":{"ref":"measure:0","direction":"desc"},"limit":10,"time":{"ref":"dimension:player_game_stats.game_date","window":{"start":"2017-01-01","end":"2018-01-01","expression":"calendar year 2017"}},"expectedShape":"ranking","unresolved":[],"provenance":{"column:dev.player_game_stats.pts":"inherited","column:dev.player_game_stats.played":"inherited","column:dev.player_game_stats.reb":"q:rebounds per game","column:dev.player_game_stats.ast":"q:assists per game","dimension:player_game_stats.player_id":"inherited","dimension:player_game_stats.player_name":"inherited","dimension:player_game_stats.game_date":"inherited"}}
